get_datasets: create train and validation datasets from Adroit expert or medium replay pickle episodes for pen or door environments
OfflineReplayBuffer_init: build an offline replay buffer from MuJoCo episodes with configurable trajectory length, discount factor, and goal-achieved reward mode
OfflineReplayBuffer_trajectory_statistic: compute and cache per-key mean, std, min, max statistics for states, actions, rewards, and returns across all trajectories
OfflineReplayBuffer_eval_logs: evaluate a behavior cloning model on the replay buffer environment and log BC, BC2, and two-stage sampling results to W&B
UseAchievedGym_step: override a GymEnv step to replace the standard reward with the goal_achieved boolean from the environment info dict
